svg.aria-label: Digital painting: a doomer maid in a striped tracksuit jacket, with a mechanical arm and a bottle of kvass, squats on a panel-block rooftop next to a cat. Beyond a red rooftop sign reading NOCHNAYA SMENA (night shift), a derelict giant robot slumps among apartment blocks, a rocket climbs past a ringed planet at dusk, and snow falls. 2233admin.

g.text: SOFTWARE THAT KEEPS WORKING AFTER THE LIGHTS GO OUT
